theme_strategy.rationale: For PrintDrop (print shop SaaS in France), a crisp, modern editorial aesthetic with warm paper stone neutrals (#F8F9FA, #F1F3F5), deep indigo ink anchor (#0B132B, #1C2541), electric cyan/azure accents (#2563EB / #0284C7), and vivid emerald status indicators (#059669) creates trust and tactile precision. The mobile customer portal is ultra-clean with tactile card surfaces, live Euro pricing indicators, and immediate drag-and-drop / camera upload flow.

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero — value proposition + CTA left with shop preview interactive calculator, live QR portal simulation card right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — value positioning panel with cybercafé illustration metrics left, login form right
entry_surfaces./register: branded registration flow — organization + cybercafé setup wizard panel left, credentials form right
entry_surfaces./s/:shopSlug: mobile-first customer upload kiosk — boutique banner header top, document dropzone center, real-time live quotation footer with instant order button
entry_surfaces./suivi/:orderCode: live status tracker — visual step progression timeline, order summary, counter pickup QR and payment state banner
entry_surfaces./dashboard: operational mission control — shop metrics bar, instant order triage Kanban/Table, printer quick-toggles and QR poster generator modal
entry_surfaces./superadmin: platform management center — multi-tenant organization directory, global revenue stats, subscription tiers and shop suspension toggles

layout_and_grids.mobile_first_rules: Touch targets minimum 48px, sticky bottom action bar on mobile customer portal with total in EUR (€), responsive collapse of kanban to tabs or single column on < 768px viewports.
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Sidebar 260px fixed on desktop + top sticky header + full height scrollable main area. 12-column bento widgets for KPI counters (col-span-3), active orders feed (col-span-8), printer status & quick actions (col-span-4).
layout_and_grids.customer_portal_layout: Max-width 540px centered mobile container with tactile card elevation (shadow-sm, border border-slate-200), sticky floating bottom bar for order validation.

visual_enhancers.paper_texture: Subtle dot-grid or millimeter graph paper pattern for print configuration preview sections.
visual_enhancers.qr_poster_generator: Real printable SVG QR code with customizable cybercafé title, instructions ('Scannez, Déposez vos fichiers, Récupérez au comptoir') with print-friendly CSS @media print styling.
visual_enhancers.status_pills: High-contrast status badges in French: 'En attente' (Amber), 'En impression' (Blue pulsant), 'Prête' (Green), 'Retirée' (Slate), 'Annulée' (Rose).

printing_options.paper_sizes: Formats de papier (A4, A3, A5, Letter, Legal)

motion.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease
motion.reduced_motion: All animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion media queries

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum for all text on background)
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory on all buttons, forms, status pills, inputs, qr displays and modal triggers (e.g. data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='order-status-badge', data-testid='mark-paid-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Default language of the entire UI and notifications MUST be French with accurate print and shop terminology.
All monetary amounts MUST be formatted with European standard format: e.g. 0,15 € or 12,50 € (never $ or USD).

Implement the 3 distinct application experiences: 1) Public & Customer portal (/s/:shopSlug and /suivi/:orderCode), 2) Cybercafé owner/staff operational dashboard (/dashboard, /orders, /settings, /printers, /team, /qr-poster), 3) Super-Admin platform control (/superadmin).

Customer portal (/s/:shopSlug) must be mobile-first optimized with seamless document drag/drop or file selection, live server-based price calculator in EUR, instant order generation, and real-time tracking link.
Provide interactive printable QR poster generator with ready-to-print CSS styling for shop counters.

Include seeded mock shops (e.g. 'CyberCafé Bastille Paris', 'CopyPrint Lyon Bellecour', 'Atelier Numérique Nantes') with realistic past and pending orders, printer list, and customized pricing schemes.
